title: The Aanderaa–Karp–Rosenberg evasiveness conjecture
area: Communication complexity and Boolean function analysis
formal: Does every nontrivial monotone isomorphism-invariant property of n-vertex simple graphs have deterministic adjacency-query complexity exactly n(n−1)/2 in the worst case?
context:
The query algorithm is deterministic and adaptive; randomized lower bounds are different conjectures. Monotonicity may be taken under edge addition.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: A basic lower-bound question about whether symmetry prevents any edge query from being avoided.
